summary: Tested the official letters module fixes (rich_text_pdf multi-space gaps, free tables, template pickTpl reset). Regression: the 4 existing letters suites pass 32/32, so plain PDF/PNG generation still works. New suite test_letters_spaces_tables_iter125.py: 16/20 pass. CRITICAL FE BUG FOUND AND FIXED: StatementBodyEditor used a default import of @tiptap/extension-table v3, which has no default export. This threw 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading configure)' and crashed /letters, statement-settings, student-details and every page using the editor. I switched it to named imports. After the fix, the table insert (3x3), add/del row, add/del col and delete-table buttons all work, cells have a 1px solid border, and the live PNG preview shows the table and the wider multi-space gap for Arabic words. Template flow passes: a template saved via the star button with a custom recipient section (blue, centered) shows correctly when picked again. Switching A->B->A->B gave the correct sections each time with no carry-over, and layout was reset to null. Found 4 open issues: DOCX export 500 when the letter contains a table; preview/PDF 500 when a section contains a table; extra spaces lost for Latin words and across formatting runs; TipTap collapses extra spaces when saved HTML is loaded back (template/draft).

critical.issue: 500 KeyError 'runs' for any letter whose body has a <table>. services/letter_docx.py _rich() line ~59 loops over para['runs'], but parse_rich now returns {'type':'table','rows':...} items that have no 'runs'. Same unsafe access at letter_docx.py:132 (sections filter).

500 KeyError 'runs' when a SECTION (recipient/greeting/subject/closing/signature) contains a table. The section editors (LetterSectionsEditor -> StatementBodyEditor) show the new '⊞ جدول' button too. Cause: services/letter_pdf.py:246 `for r in p['runs']` in the secs filter. Reproduce: sections={'recipient':'

a

سعادة

'} returns 500.

minor.issue: Extra spaces are lost between Latin (LTR) words in both right- and left-aligned paragraphs: 'AAAA    BBBB' gets the same 4.09pt gap as a single space. RCA: _visual_order reverses LTR groups, but the draw loop still does x -= w['sp'] using the current word's own gap. After reversal, that gap belongs to the logically previous word, so the wrong word's gap (1) is used. Arabic words work (16.3pt for 4 spaces). Fix: keep each word's logical index and, for each pair of adjacent drawn words, use the sp of whichever word comes first logically.

Spaces split across formatting runs are lost: '

AAA BBB

' gives gap=1 instead of 3. The leading whitespace of a run is dropped because `pending` is reset for each run. Leading spaces at the start of a paragraph are also dropped. Fix: carry the pending word across runs and add leading whitespace to the previous word's gap.

A stray/duplicate causes `ctx.pop('cur_cell_start') or 0` to return 0, which deletes every paragraph parsed before the table. Unlikely with TipTap output, but a pasted or hand-edited HTML body loses its content. Nested tables are dropped silently.

The table top border is drawn only para_gap (4pt) below the previous line's baseline, so descenders of the preceding Arabic line can touch the border. Add top spacing of about 0.4*font size. html_to_text drops table content entirely, which affects text/search exports.

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED BY TESTING AGENT: `import Table from '@tiptap/extension-table'` is undefined in v3.31.4 (named exports only), which crashed the whole page with 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading configure)'. Changed to `import { Table, TableRow, TableHeader, TableCell } from '@tiptap/extension-table'`.

Multiple spaces collapse when saved HTML is loaded into the editor (pickTpl -> setBody -> setContent, loadDraft, initial content). ProseMirror's default parse collapses whitespace. Verified: template body 'كلمة     أخرى' shows as 'كلمة أخرى' in the editor. The first preview still has the spaces because the body state is unchanged, but after ANY keystroke the emitted HTML is 'كلمة أخرى!' and the spaces are lost permanently. This defeats bug fix #1 for templates and drafts. Fix: useEditor({ parseOptions: { preserveWhitespace: 'full' } }) and pass the same parseOptions to commands.setContent(html, { emitUpdate:false, parseOptions:{preserveWhitespace:'full'} }).

integration_issues.issue: Templates do not store `layout`. The LetterTemplate model has no layout field and saveAsTemplate() does not send it. pickTpl now does setLayout({}), so any '📐 تخطيط الصفحة' advanced settings (gaps, indents, body_font/leading, QR, watermark, table font/row height, recipient_align/greeting_align/signature_align, which are synced from section alignment) are silently dropped when saving or using a template. Section HTML alignment and colour still render correctly because the HTML text-align wins in rich_sec. Either persist layout in the template (model + saveAsTemplate + pickTpl setLayout(t.layout||{})) or tell the user.

issues: The emoji labels '➕↕ ➕↔ ➖↕ ➖↔' render as ambiguous glyphs ('+:', '-:'). Use clear text labels such as '+ صف', '+ عمود', '− صف', '− عمود'.

action_items: Fix services/letter_docx.py _rich() and the line-132 sections filter to skip or render {'type':'table'} items (use p.get('runs', []) and render the table as a docx table). DOCX export currently returns 500 for letters with tables.
Fix services/letter_pdf.py:246 to use p.get('runs', []) (or treat a table as non-empty) so a table inside a section does not return 500.
Add parseOptions {preserveWhitespace:'full'} to the TipTap editor and setContent so extra spaces survive loading a template or draft.
Fix the gap attribution for reversed (LTR) visual groups in draw_rich and _draw_simple_table, and carry whitespace across runs in _words.
Decide whether templates should persist `layout`. Currently it is dropped on save and reset on pick.
Harden the _Parser handling: don't default the start index to 0.
critical_code_review_comments: Default import of a v3 TipTap package with no default export crashed every page using StatementBodyEditor. Smoke-load the page after adding dependencies.

Changing parse_rich's output shape (adding type=table items) broke every consumer that accesses p['runs'] directly (letter_docx.py x2, letter_pdf.py:246). Grep for all parse_rich consumers when the output contract changes.
The section-defaults useEffect (lhId/tplId) has no request cancellation. Switching templates quickly can let a stale response overwrite secDefaults. Low risk.

success_rate.frontend: 85% (table tools, multi-space typing+preview, template switching OK; spaces lost on template/draft reload)

seed_data_creation: Created templates TEST_ITER125_B, TEST_ITER125_A_<ts> and TEST_ITER125_C_SPACES and soft-deleted all of them afterwards. Draft letters created in the pytest are deleted in a finally block.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Browser login: the UI form + page.goto lost auth. Instead, call POST /api/auth/login via page.request and set localStorage 'token' and 'user', then goto /letters. Editor testIDs: letter-body (body), letter-layout-recipient/greeting/subject (inside the layout modal opened by letter-layout-toggle), with suffixes -insert-table and -table-add-row/-add-col/-del-row/-del-col/-delete. Template select: letter-template. Save-as-template button: letter-save-template-btn (window.prompt). Capture POST /letters/preview-pdf payloads to verify sections/layout. Run: REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=... pytest backend/tests/test_letters_spaces_tables_iter125.py plus the 4 existing letters suites.
rca of the issue: 1) Page crash: @tiptap/extension-table@3 exports only named members, so the default import is undefined and Table.configure throws. 2) DOCX/section 500: the new parse_rich table item has no 'runs' key and older consumers index it directly. 3) Latin gaps: the gap is stored on the logically-preceding word, but drawing reverses LTR groups and applies the current word's sp. 4) Editor whitespace: ProseMirror's DOMParser collapses whitespace unless preserveWhitespace is set, so reloaded HTML loses the extra spaces.
